spec.description: Combined dashboard showing table statistics and visualizations with tabbed interface

spec.title: Table Data Sizes Treemap
spec.description: Interactive treemap visualization showing table data sizes excluding indexes and TOAST. Useful for identifying tables with large amounts of actual data.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  0 as time,
  (data->>'table_size_b')::int8 + coalesce((data->>'toast_size_b')::int8, 0) as table_size_b,
  tag_data->>'table_full_name' as table_name
FROM
  table_stats
WHERE
  time = (select max(time) from table_stats WHERE dbname = '$dbname' AND $__timeFilter(time))
  AND dbname = '$dbname'
ORDER BY
  2 DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 100

spec.title: Tables with Most Disk I/O Reads
spec.description: Tables with the most disk block reads during the selected time period. Based on pg_statio_user_tables. Assumes 8KB page size. High values may indicate insufficient shared_buffers or poor indexing.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  x.*,
  (data->>'table_size_b')::int8 as data_size,
  (data->>'seq_scan')::int8 - (select (data->>'seq_scan')::int8 from table_stats where dbname = '$dbname' and tag_data->>'table_full_name' = x.table_full_name and $__timeFilter(time) order by time limit 1) as seq_scan,
  (data->>'seconds_since_last_vacuum')::int8  as last_vacuum,
  (data->>'seconds_since_last_analyze')::int8 as last_analyze
FROM (
SELECT
   tag_data->>'table_full_name' as table_full_name,
  8192 * (coalesce(max((data->>'heap_blks_read')::int8) - min((data->>'heap_blks_read')::int8), 0) + coalesce(max((data->>'toast_blks_read')::int8) - min((data->>'toast_blks_read')::int8), 0) + coalesce(max((data->>'tidx_blks_read')::int8) - min((data->>'tidx_blks_read')::int8), 0)) as blks_read
FROM
  table_io_stats
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(time)
  AND dbname = '$dbname'
GROUP BY
  1 
HAVING
  max((data->>'heap_blks_read')::int8) > min((data->>'heap_blks_read')::int8)
ORDER BY
  2 DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT
  $top
) x
join lateral (select data from table_stats where dbname = '$dbname' and tag_data->>'table_full_name' = x.table_full_name and $__timeFilter(time) order by time desc limit 1) y on true

spec.title: Largest Tables by Total Size
spec.description: Tables ranked by total relation size (table + indexes + TOAST). Click on table name to view detailed metrics for that table.

spec.rawSql:
select
  x.*,
  (data->>'seconds_since_last_vacuum')::int8 as last_vacuum,
  (data->>'seconds_since_last_analyze')::int8 as last_analyze
from (
SELECT
  tag_data->>'table_full_name' as table_full_name,
  max((data->>'total_relation_size_b')::int8) as total_relation_size,
  max((data->>'table_size_b')::int8) as data_size
FROM
  table_stats
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(time)
  AND dbname = '$dbname'
GROUP BY 1 
ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT $top
) x
join lateral (select data from table_stats where dbname = '$dbname' and tag_data->>'table_full_name' = x.table_full_name and $__timeFilter(time) order by time desc limit 1) y on true

spec.title: Largest Tables by Data Size
spec.description: Tables ranked by data size only (excluding indexes and TOAST). Click on table name to view detailed metrics for that table.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  x.*,
  (data->>'seconds_since_last_vacuum')::int8 as last_vacuum,
  (data->>'seconds_since_last_analyze')::int8 as last_analyze
FROM (
SELECT
  tag_data->>'table_full_name' as table_full_name,
  max((data->>'total_relation_size_b')::int8) as total_relation_size,
  max((data->>'table_size_b')::int8) as data_size
FROM
  table_stats
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(time)
  AND dbname = '$dbname'
GROUP BY 1 
ORDER BY 3 DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT $top
) x
join lateral (select data from table_stats where dbname = '$dbname' and tag_data->>'table_full_name' = x.table_full_name and $__timeFilter(time) order by time desc limit 1) y on true

spec.title: Index Sizes Treemap
spec.description: Interactive treemap visualization showing index sizes. Helps identify large indexes that may need optimization or rebuilding.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  0 as time,
  (data->>'index_size_b')::int8 as index_size_b,
  tag_data->>'index_full_name' as index_full_name
FROM
  index_stats
WHERE
  time = (select max(time) from index_stats WHERE dbname = '$dbname' AND $__timeFilter(time))
  AND dbname = '$dbname'
ORDER BY
  2 DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 100

spec.title: Tables with oldest non-frozen xid age
spec.description: Tables with the oldest non-frozen transaction id age.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
*
FROM
(
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (table_full_name)
  tag_data->>'table_full_name' as table_full_name,
  data->>'tx_freeze_age' as tx_freeze_age,
  (data->>'seconds_since_last_vacuum')::int8  as last_vacuum,
  (data->>'seconds_since_last_analyze')::int8 as last_analyze
  FROM
    table_stats
  WHERE
    $__timeFilter(time)
    AND dbname = '$dbname'
  ORDER BY
    1, time DESC
)
ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT $top

spec.title: Table Sizes Treemap
spec.description: Interactive treemap visualization showing relative sizes of tables and their indexes. Larger rectangles represent bigger tables.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  time,
  (data->>'total_relation_size_b')::int8 as total_relation_size_b,
  tag_data->>'table_full_name'::text as table_name
FROM
  table_stats
WHERE
  time = (select max(time) from table_stats WHERE dbname = '$dbname' AND $__timeFilter(time))
  AND dbname = '$dbname'
ORDER BY
  2 DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 100

spec.title: Tables with Most Sequential Scans
spec.description: Tables with the most sequential scans during the selected time period. Limited to tables larger than 100MB as seq scans on small tables are normal.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  x.*,
  (data->>'table_size_b')::int8 as table_size,
  (data->>'seconds_since_last_vacuum')::int8 as last_vacuum,
  (data->>'seconds_since_last_analyze')::int8 as last_analyze
FROM (
SELECT
  tag_data->>'table_full_name' as table_full_name,
  max((data->>'seq_scan')::int8) - min((data->>'seq_scan')::int8) as seq_scan
FROM
  table_stats
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(time)
  AND dbname = '$dbname'
  AND (data->>'table_size_b')::int8 > 100000000
 GROUP BY
  1 
HAVING
  max((data->>'seq_scan')::int8) > min((data->>'seq_scan')::int8)
ORDER BY
  2 DESC
LIMIT
  $top
) x
join lateral (select data from table_stats where dbname = '$dbname' and tag_data->>'table_full_name' = x.table_full_name and $__timeFilter(time) order by time desc limit 1) y on true

spec.title: Tables with Highest Growth
spec.description: Tables with the largest growth in total relation size during the selected time period. Assumes no statistics reset occurred.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  x.*,
  (data->>'seconds_since_last_vacuum')::int8 as last_vacuum,
  (data->>'seconds_since_last_analyze')::int8 as last_analyze
FROM (
  SELECT
   tag_data->>'table_full_name' as table_full_name,
    max((data->>'total_relation_size_b')::int8) - min((data->>'total_relation_size_b')::int8) as growth,
    max((data->>'total_relation_size_b')::int8) as total_relation_size
  FROM
    table_stats
  WHERE
    $__timeFilter(time)
    AND dbname = '$dbname'
  GROUP BY 1 
  ORDER BY growth DESC NULLS LAST
  LIMIT $top
) x
join lateral (select data from table_stats where dbname = '$dbname' and tag_data->>'table_full_name' = x.table_full_name and $__timeFilter(time) order by time desc limit 1) y on true

spec.title: Tables with Most INSERT Activity
spec.description: Tables with the most INSERT operations during the selected time period. Useful for identifying write-heavy tables.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  x.*,
  (data->>'total_relation_size_b')::int8 as total_relation_size,
  (data->>'seconds_since_last_vacuum')::int8 as last_vacuum,
  (data->>'seconds_since_last_analyze')::int8 as last_analyze
FROM (
SELECT
  tag_data->>'table_full_name' as table_full_name,
  max((data->>'n_tup_ins')::int8) - min((data->>'n_tup_ins')::int8) as ins
FROM
  table_stats
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(time)
  AND dbname = '$dbname'
GROUP BY
  1 
HAVING
  max((data->>'n_tup_ins')::int8) > min((data->>'n_tup_ins')::int8)
ORDER BY
  2 DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT
  $top
) x
join lateral (select data from table_stats where dbname = '$dbname' and tag_data->>'table_full_name' = x.table_full_name and $__timeFilter(time) order by time desc limit 1) y on true

spec.title: Tables with Most UPDATE Activity
spec.description: Tables with the most UPDATE operations during the selected time period. High UPDATE activity may indicate need for more frequent VACUUM operations.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  x.*,
  (data->>'total_relation_size_b')::int8 as total_relation_size,  
  (data->>'seconds_since_last_vacuum')::int8  as last_vacuum,
  (data->>'seconds_since_last_analyze')::int8 as last_analyze
FROM (
SELECT
  tag_data->>'table_full_name' as table_full_name,
  max((data->>'n_tup_upd')::int8) - min((data->>'n_tup_upd')::int8) as upd -- assumes no reset
FROM
  table_stats
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(time)
  AND dbname = '$dbname'
GROUP BY
  1 
HAVING
  max((data->>'n_tup_upd')::int8) > min((data->>'n_tup_upd')::int8)
ORDER BY
  2 DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT
  $top
) x
join lateral (select data from table_stats where dbname = '$dbname' and tag_data->>'table_full_name' = x.table_full_name and $__timeFilter(time) order by time desc limit 1) y on true

spec.title: Tables with Most DELETE Activity
spec.description: Tables with the most DELETE operations during the selected time period. High DELETE activity may indicate need for more frequent VACUUM operations.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  x.*,
  (data->>'total_relation_size_b')::int8 as total_relation_size,  
  (data->>'seconds_since_last_vacuum')::int8  as last_vacuum,
  (data->>'seconds_since_last_analyze')::int8 as last_analyze
FROM (
SELECT
   tag_data->>'table_full_name' as table_full_name,
  max((data->>'n_tup_del')::int8) - min((data->>'n_tup_del')::int8) as del -- assumes no reset
FROM
  table_stats
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(time)
  AND dbname = '$dbname'
GROUP BY
  1 
HAVING
  max((data->>'n_tup_del')::int8) > min((data->>'n_tup_del')::int8)
ORDER BY
  2 DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT
  $top
) x
join lateral (select data from table_stats where dbname = '$dbname' and tag_data->>'table_full_name' = x.table_full_name and $__timeFilter(time) order by time desc limit 1) y on true
